function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment arm is significantly more severe (41.3% severe vs 4.9% in control) and slightly younger (54.8 vs 55.4), but sex is balanced. Since severity is a strong predictor of response and is systematically different between arms, the raw difference in response rates is confounded by severity. The treatment effect cannot be estimated reliably without adjustment.", "implication": "The question asks for a difference in proportions (treatment minus control), but the groups are not comparable due to imbalance in severity. function.name: note_finding
